subject: Lazy loading of RDMA libs in CLI/Benchmark when building as module (#3072)
reason: Build-system-only change: it adds USE_DLOPEN_RDMA/ENABLE_DLOPEN_RDMA flags and drops RDMA_LIBS from the valkey-cli/valkey-benchmark link line when BUILD_RDMA=module, so the RDMA client library is dlopen'd lazily instead of being a hard link dependency. No source file changes; server commands, replication, persistence and tool behaviour are identical. The only path affected is startup/linking of the tools in an RDMA-module build using the RDMA transport, which requires RDMA libraries and hardware that the fuzzer's local throwaway environment does not have, so no scenario can reach it.
